usage: Countable or uncountable depending on meaning: 木 can mean "wood" as a material, and also a "tree" in some set phrases or older usage.
Common in everyday talk about furniture, construction, crafts, and nature. It often sits after a classifier when you mean a piece or type of wood.
Very neutral register. Easy learner word, but watch the context: if you mean a living tree, Cantonese often uses 樹 instead of 木.
Often appears in compounds and set phrases such as 木門, 木枱, 木頭, and 木工.
